findings.subject: workspace: release pipeline and CI
findings.summary: npm `latest` is stale on all 8 published packages (ui-react latest 0.2.0-beta.9 from 2026-09-24 vs beta 0.2.0-beta.12) because the trusted publisher cannot move dist-tags; the publish job fails after publishing, so tags and registry evidence are skipped too, and README.md tells consumers a plain install gets the beta.
findings.evidence: Release beta run 44371320697: 'npm error 403 403 Forbidden - PUT .../@atom63%2fstyles/dist-tags/latest - This trusted publisher cannot manage dist-tags'. npm view @atom63/<pkg> dist-tags (2026-11-19): styles latest 0.1.0-beta.5 / beta 0.1.0-beta.8; ui-foundation 0.1.1-beta.2 / 0.2.0-beta.5; ui-react 0.2.0-beta.9 / 0.2.0-beta.12; mdx 0.4.0-beta.0 / 0.4.0-beta.3; inform 0.2.0-beta.0 / 0.2.0-beta.3; agent 0.3.0-beta.0 / 0.3.0-beta.1; widgets 0.1.0-beta.0 / 0.1.0-beta.3; cli 0.1.0-beta.0 / 0.1.0-beta.1. README.md:15-17 claims latest follows beta; release-automation.md:42 says 'Allow npm dist-tag' must be enabled. No git tag for ui-react@0.2.0-beta.12 (git ls-remote --tags). Untagged installs documented in packages/inform/README.md:6, packages/widgets/README.md:7, packages/agent/README.md:7, packages/ui-foundation/README.md:23.
findings.fix: Enable 'Allow npm dist-tag' on each package's trusted publisher (YZ/maintainer on npmjs.com), rerun the dist-tag step (or `npm dist-tag add <pkg>@<beta> latest` once), then add a CI/registry-smoke assertion that latest == beta for every published package and run check:stable-release-preflight in CI over all 8 packages.

verified.reason: Reproduced. `npm view` shows `latest` behind `beta` on all 8 packages, exactly as stated (for example ui-react latest 0.2.0-beta.9, beta 0.2.0-beta.12). The failed-job log of run 44371320697 shows `PUT .../@atom63%2fstyles/dist-tags/latest` returning 403 with "This trusted publisher cannot manage dist-tags". In that run Publish beta = failure and Record registry smoke evidence = skipped. `git ls-remote --tags origin` has no ui-react@0.2.0-beta.12, styles@0.1.0-beta.8 or mdx@0.4.0-beta.3 tag (ui-react stops at beta.11). README.md:15-17 still says a plain install gets the beta, and stable-release-policy.json sets latest.followsBetaBeforeStable:true. packages/{agent,ui-foundation,widgets,inform}/README.md tell readers to use an untagged `pnpm add`, which installs the stale `latest`. The fix is to enable 'Allow npm dist-tag' in npm settings (release-automation.md:42), but until then the A5 dist-tag and registry evidence is broken and the docs are wrong. P1 holds. Note: the later Release beta runs (2026-11-19/20) succeed only because nothing new was published.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx
findings.summary: @atom63/mdx labels 13 of 14 entries 'stable' (a major-version compatibility promise) while it is 0.4.0-beta.3, stable promotion is not approved, and it has broken exports in a patch before; 20 of its public types cannot be imported by name.
findings.evidence: docs/design-system/package-export-tiers.json (@atom63/mdx: '.','./blocks','./article','./editor','./runtime','./lightbox' ... 'stable'); packages/mdx/README.md:17-26; tierDefinitions.stable 'breaking changes need a major version'; docs/design-system/audits/stable-release-preflight.json stablePromotionApproved:false; packages/mdx/CHANGELOG.md:105 (0.3.2 removed mdxTypography.docsBody/docsLead/docsListItem); ae-forgotten-export in packages/mdx/api/mdx.api.md (MdxComponentsMap, ComparisonContextValue, MdxParagraph, MdxCode, MdxAnchor, MdxImage), mdx.blocks.api.md (CompareItem, StepsStep, TimelineItem, ScrollStageStep, VideoCaptionPolicy, CodeBlockVariant, MediaSpacing, TableOfContentsVariant, MdxPageSkeletonVariant, aspectRatioClasses, fitClasses), mdx.primitives.api.md (MdxFrameHeading, spacingClasses).
findings.fix: Retier the mdx entries 'beta' (primitives stays experimental) in package-export-tiers.json and the README until the stable promotion is approved; export or inline the 20 unnameable types; make the package-surface check reject 'stable' on a prerelease version.

verified.reason: Real but overstated. package-export-tiers.json gives @atom63/mdx 13 stable entries and 1 experimental, while stable-release-preflight.json has stablePromotionApproved:false and the package is 0.4.0-beta.3. The tier file was only added on 2026-11-19 (fb39cb08) and copies the existing README Stability table, so no break has happened under the tier promise yet. The top-level README beta banner also says APIs can change before stable. The 'broken exports in a patch' point is real but misdated: the mdxTypography.docsBody/docsLead/docsListItem removal sits under 0.3.1 in the CHANGELOG, not 0.3.2. The ae-forgotten-export claim holds roughly: 19 distinct symbols are referenced in the mdx API reports but exported from no entry (CodeBlockVariant, CompareItem, ComparisonContextValue, MdxComponentsMap, StepsStep, TimelineItem, VideoCaptionPolicy, TableOfContentsVariant, ScrollStageStep, MediaSpacing, MdxPageSkeletonVariant, plus value symbols such as MdxAnchor and aspectRatioClasses). That is an ergonomics gap, not something that breaks consumers. The tier labelling is inconsistent and should become 'beta' to meet 'tiered honestly' in A3, but it is a one-line fix that consumers can work around, not a ready blocker.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx, @atom63/inform, @atom63/widgets
findings.summary: mdx, inform and widgets take @atom63/ui-react as a regular dependency pinned to an exact version, so a consumer whose ui-react differs gets a second ui-react copy (split theme/UIProvider contexts, duplicate CSS); with the stale latest tags the documented untagged installs already mix versions.

Quickstart installs ui-react@beta (docs/design-system/quickstart.md:12) while packages/widgets/README.md:7 installs `@atom63/widgets @atom63/ui-react` untagged.
findings.fix: Make @atom63/ui-react (and @atom63/styles in mdx) a peer dependency of mdx, inform and widgets with a workspace:^ range (kept as a devDependency for the build), and extend check:dependency-version-policy to require it.

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-react
findings.summary: The ui-react budget is a ratchet with 0.6 kB headroom that measures the summed gzip of every dist file, so it neither reflects a consumer's real cost nor stops growth (raised 13 times, 64 -> 100 kB); tree-shaking is only checked for react-day-picker.
findings.evidence: sweep-r1/ui-react-size.log '99.4 kB gzip / 100 kB budget'; scripts/design-system/check-ui-react-bundle-size.mjs:8-80 (history of raises); CI run 44489359587 failed at 98.1 kB on 2026-11-19 and the budget moved to 100 in #291; check-ui-react-root-deps.mjs:25 guards only react-day-picker; root graph statically imports react-hook-form, embla-carousel-react, input-otp, sonner, react-resizable-panels.
findings.fix: Add per-entry budgets measured by bundling representative consumer imports (e.g. `import { Button }`, `import { Dialog }`, root `*`, ./media) with esbuild/rollup and a headroom floor, and extend the root-deps list to embla, input-otp, sonner, react-resizable-panels and react-hook-form (or move Form/Carousel/InputOTP/Resizable to subpaths).

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-react
findings.summary: The dependency policy claims protections consumers do not get: input-otp is 'pinned via root override' but publishes as ^1.4.2, and react-hook-form is a required peer that every root import loads even for apps without forms.
findings.evidence: docs/design-system/dependency-version-policy.json runtimeDependencyPolicy['@atom63/ui-react']['input-otp'] 'pin-via-root-override-through-beta'; root package.json pnpm.overrides input-otp 1.4.2 (repo-only); packages/ui-react/package.json dependencies input-otp ^1.4.2; peerDependencies react-hook-form ^7.81.0 with no peerDependenciesMeta; react-hook-form imported by packages/ui-react/dist/index.js.
findings.fix: Pin input-otp exactly in packages/ui-react/package.json (or change the policy text), and either mark react-hook-form optional and move Form to a subpath (like ./calendar) or document that it is required.

findings.subject: workspace: release pipeline and CI
findings.summary: The webkit sign-in flake is still live and cross-browser runs also die on browser disconnects; there is no retry policy or flake register, so a flake blocks ci-status and the release preflight that waits on it.
findings.evidence: Run 44203452194 job 134463220865: 'FAIL cross-browser (webkit) packages/templates/src/pages/sign-in-page/sign-in-page.stories.tsx > Wrong Password' (1 failed | 1727 passed); story waits with findByText default timeout (sign-in-page.stories.tsx:43). Run 44480011569 job 135409704834: VITEST_BROWSER_CONNECTION_CLOSED. .github/workflows/release-beta.yml preflight requires ci-status success. No 'flak'/'retry' in .github or apps/storybook.
findings.fix: Give the Wrong Password play an explicit findByText timeout (or wait for the form's submitting state to clear), add `retry: 1` to the cross-browser Vitest project only, and keep a short flake list in docs with each test's run evidence.

findings.subject: workspace: release pipeline and CI
findings.summary: Release automation leaves gaps after a failed publish: git tags for the 2026-11-18 versions were never pushed and registry-consumer-smoke.json had to be regenerated by hand, because record-evidence needs the publish job to succeed.
findings.evidence: git ls-remote --tags origin: newest ui-react tag @atom63/ui-react@0.2.0-beta.11; release-beta.yml record-evidence `needs: publish`; registry-consumer-smoke.json last changed in #296 by hand (git log).
findings.fix: Split the latest dist-tag move into its own job after record-evidence (or make it non-fatal with a loud annotation), so tags and evidence are recorded whenever the versions reached npm.
